outcome: Seropositivity for anti-Toxoplasma gondii IgG and IgM antibodies
cohort: 200 Yoremes (an indigenous ethnic group) in the locality of Tierra Blanca, Navojoa, Sonora State, Mexico (mean age: 31.50±18.43 years)
finding: Toxoplasma gondii exposure among Yoremes was 13%, and it was associated with increasing age and consumption of squirrel meat.
mod_finding: In women, T. gondii exposure was associated with a history of caesarean sections and miscarriages.
